blockNote: Title scene $FC intro actor (Bank 0B, 772391-772487, plus the comet actor and an unreferenced palette-fade stub below it). Spawned with sFC_title_start_handler by scene_event_0CE56D, the title scene's actor list.

Loads the title palette, spawns TitleCometSpriteActor, shows two BG3 text strings on a timer and, after a ~42-second idle period ($09D3 frames), sets event flag $F4 and queues scene $8C (the prologue). Flag $F4 is tested by pr8C_prologue1 (BranchOnFlagByte, branch when clear) and pr8C_prologue5 (branch when set) and cleared again in pr8C_prologue1, so it marks 'the prologue was started by the title's idle timeout'.
=== DISPLAY LAYERS ===

TM starts at $10 (OBJ only: the comet sprites are the first thing on screen; the title picture is not on a main-screen layer yet). TitleCometSpriteActor later writes TM = $16 (BG2 + BG3 + OBJ) after its sprite animation, which brings in the title picture and the BG3 text layer.
=== TEXT TIMING ===
Two BG3 text scripts are shown in sequence:
- consolestring_01DA5E after $B3 frames (179 frames, ~3 seconds)
- consolestring_01DA47 after $77 more frames (119 frames, ~2 seconds)

TitleIntroInit: Actor entry: set the display flags, load the palettes (pal_title over CGRAM colours 0-31, then pal_ending_comet over colours 0-7), spawn the comet, set TM = $10, then run the timed text sequence and the idle wait that ends in the queued change to the prologue scene.
TitleCometSpriteActor: Title comet sprite actor (spawned by TitleIntroInit at ($80,$50)). Runs animation #00 for 240 loop cycles in place, then 64 loop cycles with X speed 2 (StageSpriteLoopMoveX), waits 59 frames, switches TM to $16 and parks on SetEntryHere. Its frames come from spm_title_actors.
TitlePaletteFadeStep: Palette-animation stub: PaletteStart #2D (45 decimal), one PaletteStep, then Die. No spawn or pointer to it exists anywhere in extracted/ (UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME whether anything reaches it).

blockNote: Diary-menu highlight-band thinker for scene $FA (Bank 00, 48049-48203; spawned through thinker_spawn_0CEB18, the scene-$FA slot of the scene thinker table).

Every frame it chooses HDMA tables for the PPU window-1 position registers WH0/WH1 ($2126/$2127; the operand #26 of COP QueueDma is that B-bus register, see hdma_channel_config) from three cursor words kept by sFA_diary_menu, where a negative value means 'none': $0D92 = slot cursor, $0D96 = copy-target slot, $0D98 = tab / settings-row cursor. DiaryMenuInit sets WOBJSEL = $22 (window 1 is the colour window) and CGWSEL = $82 (main screen black inside it), so each table lays a band over the rows under a cursor; the band appearance is decoded from the registers, not observed (OQ-I057-3).
=== TABLES ===

Each dma-channel entry is one HDMA step: line count, WH0 (left), WH1 (right); the assembler appends the $00 terminator, so an array is 3n + 1 bytes and an empty array is a lone terminator (no band). WH0 = $FF with WH1 = $00 is an empty window (left > right), i.e. no band on those lines.

- No part notes on dma_channel_00BC4C / dma_channel_00BC4D on purpose: the transforms.json rule for this block swaps those two labels with a regex that needs them adjacent, and a note line between them stops it matching (the ROM then loses a byte). dma_channel_00BC4C is the empty table (terminator only, no band); dma_channel_00BC4D is the slot-1 band.

- Slot bands (31 lines tall, x = $10-$F0): dma_channel_00BC4D starts at line 79 (slot 1), dma_channel_00BC57 at line 111 (slot 2), dma_channel_00BC61 at line 143 (slot 3; two empty entries of $10 + $7F lines because one count cannot exceed $7F).

- Tab / row bands (15 lines tall, x = $30-$D0): dma_channel_00BC6F at line 79, dma_channel_00BC79 at 95, dma_channel_00BC83 at 111, dma_channel_00BC8D at 127. dma_channel_00BC4C and dma_channel_00BC6E are the empty tables.
=== SELECTION ===

1. Slot cursor $0D92 (first QueueDma): negative writes WH0/WH1 = $FF/$00 directly and queues the empty table; 0 / 1 / 2+ queue the slot-1 / slot-2 / slot-3 band. While a copy target is set ($0D96 >= 0) this band is only queued on odd frames (even frames queue the empty table), so the source row flickers at 30 Hz.
2. Target cursor $0D96 (second QueueDma): same mapping, always queued.
3. Tab cursor $0D98 (third QueueDma): negative = empty table, 0 / 1 / 2 / 3+ = the four narrow bands.
Each COP QueueDma takes its own direct-table HDMA channel, so the three tables overlay each other on the same registers.

loc_00BBC7: Queue the empty table dma_channel_00BC4C (no band) and continue with the target cursor.
loc_00BBCF: Slot cursor 0 -> dma_channel_00BC4D (band at line 79); other values continue the compare chain.
loc_00BBE4: Slot cursor 2 or higher -> dma_channel_00BC61 (band at line 143).

loc_00BC45: Tab 3 or higher -> dma_channel_00BC8D (band at line 127), RTL.
dma_channel_00BC57: Slot-2 band: 111 empty lines, 31 lines of window x = $10-$F0, 96 empty lines.
dma_channel_00BC61: Slot-3 band: 143 empty lines (as $10 + $7F), 31 lines of window x = $10-$F0, 96 empty lines.

blockNote: Diary / save menu actor for scene $FA (Bank 0B, 778810-783347 plus the dialog strings): the 4-tab menu shown after the title screen - Start Journey, Erase Trip Diary, Copy Trip Diary, Change Snd/Buttons - over the three save slots.

Entry: TitleToDiaryTransition (sFC_title_start_handler) queues scene $FA at ($100,$370); the prologue scenes $8C-$8F also spawn the Start-poll actor sFC_actor_0BC9BD, so Start there lands here too. The scene background is the overworld map (scene_meta_00FA: display-mode #08, set_overworld / map_overworld_main, music bgm_beautiful_world). DiaryCameraPan scrolls it to the location stored in diary_entry_table for the highlighted slot's source scene.
=== DISPLAY SETUP (DiaryMenuInit) ===

TM = $01 (BG1), TS = $04 (BG3 on the sub screen), so the BG3 text is colour-math-blended over BG1: CGWSEL = $82 (main screen forced black inside the colour window, addend = sub screen), CGADSUB = $41 (add, half intensity, BG1 only). WOBJSEL = $22 enables window 1 for the colour window and the OBJ window; WH0/WH1 are fed by diary_menu_window_dma, which draws the highlight bands (see that file). W34SEL = $88 enables window 2 for BG3/BG4. The camera starts at ($80,$300); displayModeFlags |= $4001 (bit 14 = HUD off, bit 0 = full BG3 upload). Start and Select are masked out of joypadCurrent ($3000 in joypadMaskStd), playerFlags $2800 (script lock $0800 + guard stance $2000) is set until the menu leaves, and the D-pad auto-repeats ($0F00 in joypadMaskInv). The black-inside-window look is decoded from the registers, not observed (OQ-I057-3).
RunBg3Script consolestring_01EADC draws the button legend box (A Button: Enter / B Button: Cancel).
=== DIARY STATE BLOCK ($0D74-$0D9E) ===
| Address | Purpose |
| $0D74/76/78 | Source scene ID (sourceSceneId $0B12 of the slot's save page) for slots 1/2/3; 0 = empty or invalid |
| $0D7A/7C/7E | Max HP (playerMaxHp $0ACA) for slots 1/2/3 |
| $0D80/82/84 | DEF (playerDef $0ADC) for slots 1/2/3 |
| $0D86/88/8A | STR (playerStr $0ADE) for slots 1/2/3 |
| $0D8C | Active / last-used slot (0-2), mirrored in SRAM $306000 |
| $0D8E | Button type setting (0 = Type 1, 1 = Type 2); saved in the slot page at $0B26 |
| $0D90 | Sound setting (0 = stereo, 1 = mono); saved in the slot page at $0B24 |
| $0D92 | Slot cursor (0-2, $FFFF = none); drives the slot band |
| $0D94 | Slot being edited (Snd/Buttons editor, arrangement screen, erase prompt) |
| $0D96 | Copy target slot ($FFFF = none); drives a second slot band |
| $0D98 | Tab cursor (0-3) or settings-row cursor (0-2), $FFFF = none; drives the narrow band |
| $0D9A/9C/9E | BCD scratch for the stat strings: HP / STR / DEF |
=== SRAM LAYOUT ===

$306000 holds the last-used slot (0-2). Slot n's page is $306200 + n*512: a copy of WRAM $0A00-$0BFB (508 bytes). Its additive checksum is at $3063FC + n*512 and its XOR checksum at $3063FE + n*512 (both seeded with $3652, computed by save_system.ComputeSaveChecksum with X = n*512). The two settings live inside the page at $0B24 (sound) and $0B26 (button type).
=== BUTTON TYPES ===

ApplySoundAndRemap (run when a game starts) reads sound $0B24 and button type $0B26. Type 1 (0) sets remapA = $8000, remapB = $4000, remapX = 0, remapY = $0040; Type 2 (1) only sets remapX = 0 and leaves the other remaps at their current values (the engine defaults). The on-screen legend (dialogstring_0BF63F / 0BF653) reads 'Type 1: A, B, SEL, Y' and 'Type 2: B, Y, SEL, A' against the rows Attack/Talk, Item/Cancel, Item palette, Not used. This baserom's system_init transform changes the default remaps (remapA $8080, remapB $4008, remapY $0040, remapX $0004) and the menu's own button tests ($8000 confirm, $4000 cancel), so what Type 2 does here is unverified (OQ-I057-1).

The erase prompt temporarily remaps B/Y in vanilla; transforms.json strips those stubs from the plain extraction, but multi-line rules do not apply under extract:lt (OQ-I026-1), so the stubs stay visible in the line-tracked text.
=== UNREFERENCED CODE ===

Nine routines carry the _noref suffix and have no callers: a BG3 cursor engine (DiaryCursorNav_noref; its helpers DiaryCursorApplyMove ... DiaryClearAllCursors and table_0BED3C are only reached from it), a controller-2 debug set at 782712-783013 (DiaryJoypadFilter_noref, DiaryResetCounter_noref, DiaryIncCounter_noref, DiaryDigitDisplay_noref, DiaryUnused24B_noref, DiaryReadJoy2_noref, DiaryNullHandler_noref, DiaryAwaitButtonRelease_noref). DiaryMenuVBlankHandler is a copy of VBlankWaitAndJoypad whose only caller is the unreferenced DiaryAwaitButtonRelease_noref; the live menu uses the engine's VBlankWaitAndJoypad and its remap.

DiaryScanSramSlots: Scan the three SRAM slots into the diary state block. The scene-ID, HP and DEF fields ($0D74-$0D84) are zeroed first (the second block of three stores repeats $0D80-$0D84, so the STR fields $0D86-$0D8A are never zeroed; they are only shown for slots with a nonzero scene ID, which overwrites them). Reads $306000 (last-used slot, reset to 0 when >= 3) into $0D8C. For slots 2, 1, 0 it recomputes both checksums and, when they match, copies sourceSceneId ($0B12), playerMaxHp ($0ACA), playerDef ($0ADC) and playerStr ($0ADE) from the slot page; $26 collects one validity bit per slot (bit n = slot n).

Read with 8-bit A they are LDA $E1 / BIT #$40 / BEQ (to the RTL) / LDA #$04 / JSL $82:81C9 (WaitFrames) / RTL: holding Y ($4000 in the $E0 word) on controller 2 adds a 4-frame wait (slow motion). An overrides.json M = 1 entry at 782923 would extract it correctly (renames ledger R-I057-4).

DiaryAwaitButtonRelease_noref: Unreferenced pause helper: if A is down ($0080 in joypadRaw) wait for it to be released, then for a fresh press, then for the release again, running the diary VBlank handler each frame - a press-A-to-pause toggle.

DiaryMenuVBlankHandler: Copy of the engine's VBlankWaitAndJoypad: waits for VBlank (RDNMI), uploads the Mode 7 registers when scrollModeFlags bit 3 is set, honours joypadInject, builds joypadRemapped from the D-pad plus each remap word (remapStart ... remapR), publishes it to joypadCurrent / joypadRaw, and applies the consumption mask, the 12-frame auto-repeat on joypadMaskInv and joypadMaskStd. Its only caller is the unreferenced DiaryAwaitButtonRelease_noref, so the live menu never runs it.
